headline: Saudi Aramco Offers Discounted Oil to Europe as Exports Recover
summary: Saudi Aramco is offering additional crude oil cargoes to European refiners for October and November loading at a discount following pipeline disruptions.
why: Adjustments to official selling prices and spot discounts signal supply adjustments by major Middle Eastern producers seeking to maintain market share.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabian Oil Co.
impacts.why: Offering discounted spot cargoes helps restore export volumes following infrastructure disruptions but may impact near-term realization prices.

why_moved: Spot discounts and incremental cargo offerings alter pricing dynamics for European refiners seeking alternative Middle Eastern crude supplies.
